description: GP01 project-owned additions and byte edits. Offsets address the hash-pinned external vendor example; no removed vendor source or unchanged context is embedded.

changes.insert:
Vapor board transport. 32-bit external-clock GPIF, USB OUT 0x02 ->
 * PIB socket 3; PIB socket 0 -> USB IN 0x86. Two automatic DMA channels
 * use four 16 KiB buffers each. CPU callbacks count buffers/errors only;
 * no CPU buffer commit or payload copying is used. See GPIF_MAPPING.md
